text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's anyone's race! With the star-studded 
Arima Kinen drawing to a close! Who will 
be the first to cross the finish line!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(If I could leap beyond that light you 
possess... just how far could I go?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“...And that is precisely why I will 
triumph over youuuu!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, here comes Sakura Laurel! Pushing 
forward! Surging ahead, she's forcefully 
carved a path to victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the cheers of the massive 
crowd, Sakura Laurel and the others race 
down the Nakayama straight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving tracks of horseshoes behind her. 
Streaking across the same turf, like a 
single ray of light—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Sakura! Sakura!! Capping off the 
year-end Grand Prix in style is Sakura 
Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...We've both gotten stronger since the 
Japan Cup, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I could compete against you. 
Having you there made me so much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how cold! And here I thought we'd 
gotten closer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If we keep competing against each other 
like this, I wonder how far we can go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Chasing, sometimes overtaking. And then 
being overtaken, only to overtake again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: If I could just keep running like that, I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I felt like I could reach the summit, to 
a view that no one had ever seen before."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, today, I saw it more 
clearly than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you want to aim for it with me? 
That place of dreams—beyond this sky.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll just chase after you on my own 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, your voice is super loud. Did 
something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: And then I had another dream!
And then I had another dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the dream where you and Brian race 
against each other!

Yeah, a dream where you and Brian race 
against each other!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Is there perhaps some special thread 
connecting the two of us?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Um, was the dream stage where 
Brian-chan and I were competing against 
each other... the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder why that is, truly. Fufu...♪"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(—Is it because we've always been looking 
in the exact same direction?)
